audio.text: Would you rather study at the library or at the café?

options: Yes, I'd like to study tonight.
The library's quieter, so let's go there.

why.en: Choice question → a choice with a reason. A answers "Yes" to an either/or question.
why.tr: Seçim sorusu → gerekçeli seçim. A "ya o ya bu" sorusuna "Evet" diyor.
why.es: Pregunta de elección → una elección con un motivo. A responde "Yes" a una pregunta de "esto o aquello".
